headings.rationale: Provides the requested 'editorial enterprise feel', avoiding generic tech sans-serifs.
headings.usage: Use tracking-tight for massive heroes. Never center-align by default.

body.rationale: Clean, highly readable, offsets the classical serif header with functional tech utility.

data_numbers.rationale: Sterile Mono Body for numerical accuracy in a data-heavy application. Crucial for financial tabulations.

formatting.currency: MANDATORY: Full Indian format (₹xx,xx,xx,xxx). Absolutely NO compact Cr/L rounding.
formatting.hero_figure: Show 'Rupees [Amount in Words] Only' directly beneath the massive hero metric.

background.rationale: Warm off-white background as explicitly requested.

accents.highlight_usage: Use EXTREMELY RARELY. E.g., for the 'Vault attach rate' badge or a single 'verified' pip.

revenue_streams.land: Neutral earthy grayscale (#4A4A4A) with warm background.
revenue_streams.vault: Use the main accent Powder Blue (#9BBAD4) to distinguish this parallel stream.

grids_and_layouts.philosophy: Editorial Grid / The Technical Look. Reject generic admin-card floating layouts.
grids_and_layouts.structure: Use sharp 1px borders (border-collapse style) to divide sections like a financial newspaper. High density but optical clarity. Remove border radius (rounded-none or rounded-sm).
grids_and_layouts.dual_stream_strategy: Segment the Land vs Vault streams using a split-column architecture within the per-project and overall portfolio views. Projects without Vault will gracefully span 100% of the space showing only Land data.
grids_and_layouts.spacing: Generous Spacing inside cells (p-6 or p-8 inside bordered grid items) to maintain the premium feel.

components.cards: DO NOT use standard glossy cards with drop shadows. Use flat, rectangular, cardless layouts divided by sharp 1px borders.
components.headers: Editorial greeting header with Date + top meta. Use large Serif.
components.tables: Flat, flush borders. Data aligned right for numbers, left for text. Use IBM Plex Mono for figures.
components.activity_feed: Minimalist chronological list. No heavy backgrounds, rely on typography for hierarchy.

motion.hover: Subtle background shifts (e.g., hover:bg-[#F3F2EF]). No large translation or drop shadow increases.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure text meets APCA standard. Near-black on warm off-white.
accessibility.data_testid: MANDATORY. Add data-testid attributes to all interactive elements, tabs, forms, and buttons.

instructions_to_main_agent: Build a React (.js) + Tailwind CSS dashboard. Do NOT use TypeScript (.tsx).
DO NOT CHANGE FUNCTIONALITY. Ensure same data and same actions, purely a visual/layout rethink.
Ensure 'The Vault' is conditionally rendered (e.g., Vacation Village degrades cleanly and does not show it).
Display ALL money in full Indian format (₹xx,xx,xx,xxx) without Cr/L rounding.
Show a 'Rupees ... Only' words line beneath the Hero metric.
Use Phosphor Icons, Lucide-react, or simple SVG for sharp, premium iconography.
Reject standard 'Shadcn Card' component looks. Use flat divs with border-border 1px lines.
Create a stream-segmented redesign (Land vs Vault).
Provide a toggle/view to see a bolder full creative-redesign ALTERNATIVE blueprint to compare.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: Never use generic centered layouts, simplistic gradients, and uniform styling.
Do NOT apply 'transition: all'. Explicitly state transition properties.
Never use placeholder image URLs (via.placeholder.com etc.). Use the URLs provided in the media section.
Avoid using emoji characters as icons.
Use solid backgrounds for drop-downs/headers over content. NO transparent overlays.
Ensure generous spacing. Cramped designs look cheap.
